ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with a low-intensity (black) margin restricted to the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white pixel field across the interior lobes. A continuous black band follows the trailing edge geometry. Five distinct small, circular low-intensity (black) pixel blobs are distributed across the white field: two on the left lobe (one distal, one medial) and three on the right lobe (one medial, two proximal to the waterline).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 100 degrees and a deep vertical depth relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5-15 pixels, forming a jagged boundary along the entire black trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve transitioning from the median notch toward the lateral tips, with a slight upward vertical lift at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast, multi-tonal (white, grey, and tan) circular pixel groups located on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle clusters on the distal tips of both lobes; several small, isolated dark circular spots/depressions on the white ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy accumulation of calcified organisms on the outer edges creates a non-linear, lumpy silhouette at the fluke tips.
